name: Olympus BondFixedExpiryTeller unvalidated bond redemption
summary: BondFixedExpiryTeller.redeem() trusted the caller-supplied bond token's underlying and expiry values without verifying that the token was created by the teller. The attacker supplied a forged bond token, burned its arbitrary balance, and made the teller transfer its real OHM reserves.
notes: The vulnerable redeem function executes directly in the teller's immutable runtime. The address had no code immediately before the CREATE2 transaction, and its 14,435-byte runtime hash at deployment matches the pre-exploit hash.
The exploit receipt contains one asset outflow: exactly 30,437.077948152 OHM transferred from BondFixedExpiryTeller to the attack helper.
